title: Weekend Grindhouse Schedule - Fri 10/16 - Sun 10/18
contentHtml:
Playing this weekend @ 420Grindhouse.

Showtime starts each day @ 3pm EST/12pm PST.

  • Monster Night (2006) aka Trick or Treat
  • Wacko (1982)
  • Blacula (1972)

Friday Grindhouse-A-Go-Go

  • Night of the Werewolf (1981)
  • Night of the Comet (1989)
  • Night of the Scarecrow (1995)

Friday Night Freak Show

  • Pumpkinhead (1988)
  • Hayride to Hell (2022)

==Saturday==
